coverageLimits: The Canvas matrix covers two reduced-motion idle samples; the remaining reduced-motion controller conditions belong to the separate targeted code tests.

A fresh insertion-grace sample verifies that the retained native shot has no projectile and no emission pose. Successful salvo fixtures begin after4.05seconds of real native updates at insertion; the grace field is not manually cleared.
Pose selection samples are declared native-field fixtures. The causal firing and death sequences use real production controller/update calls and are recorded separately.
No browser journey, audio, networked deployment or whole campaign completion is established by this Canvas receipt.
Native corpse opacity0.3 applies per component; overlap accumulates. The far arms on the final corpse are present but partially hidden and visible through later translucent layers.
The raw PNGs retain very-low-alpha fringe noise. No pixel-cleaning or source-crop operation was performed.
The source emission crest is about1.2pixels below the health bar and the final near hand about0.15pixel above the ground; exact raster observations are in the frame records.
HUD parent comparison excludes only rows178..199 for the one intentional Queen Mother adaptation-notice change. Hive World and Pangaea are compared without exclusions.
Official red NECA photographs ground the visual adaptation; this is not global franchise1:1 certification.

The first death sequence used isolated drawEnemy frames while the gameplay camera stayed at insertion; it is retained as historical evidence. A targeted three-image supplement now shows real world draws at0,0.3,1.25seconds plus viewport/controller observations without images at0.15and1.1seconds.

The visible death supplement retains actual native reinforcements, name overlap, acid and residual warning. It establishes lifetime/admission and does not claim that all corpse parts are readable through these foreground actors.
Native Canvas represents the requested alpha0.3 as0.2980392156862745 on each direct image call. This quantization and opacity accumulation are recorded without a group-alpha substitution.
The English world HUD uses the existing native term MOTHER QUEEN in some labels and QUEEN MOTHER in the new adaptation notice; no terminology rewrite was part of this art batch.

initialOffscreenDeathSequence.reason: The main matrix observes the real corpse clocks and draws the body with drawEnemy in isolation, but the actual gameplay camera remains at insertion. Its false viewport membership is not evidence of early corpse removal. The supplement below supplies the visible-world lifetime evidence.

visibleDeathSupplement.reason: The original death sequence drew bodies in isolation while the actual camera remained at insertion. This supplement observes real world draw and visibility from a naturally settled combat camera.
visibleDeathSupplement.limitation: Native reinforcements and their overlapping names partially cover the corpse. These world frames prove admission and expiry, not full corpse readability. The isolated body images retain the anatomy detail.

visualReview.status: Native composition accepted by root. Independent visual review reports no new defect after inspecting the overview and all three visible-death world captures; exact final receipt hash acknowledgement is recorded separately.

finalCorpseArtRaster.method: Exact observed native image draws replayed alone for alpha measurement; no source or game render is changed

runtimeValidation.author: /root/broodstorm_review
runtimeValidation.scope: Presentation helper, exclusive ecosystem hooks, dedicated verification; no commit, API, build, publication or global canon certification.

initialRun.format: Node default spec reporter despite .tap extension

diagnosis.observed: Target and LOS were valid, three choirs were neutralized, native attackClock reset to 2.15 and windup to 0, but no projectile remained after updateEnemy.
diagnosis.cause: withInsertionSafeZoneV188 wraps the ecosystem update. During 4 s of native insertion grace it tracks insertionGraceEnemyV188 and truncates newly appended hostileProjectiles in finally. An append inside the inner producer does not yet mean the outer mixin accepts the shot.
diagnosis.runtimeCorrection: markQueenMotherSalvoV188 returns false exactly when engine.insertionGraceEnemyV188 === actor. No modification to the projectile producer or insertion-safe-zone module.
diagnosis.fixtureCorrection: Run 4.05 s of real engine updates at insertion, assert grace inactive, then unlock/reposition the target and stimulate native windup. No direct disabling of the protection.
diagnosis.regression: The same causal test first calls the real producer during grace, observes held count +1, zero retained projectiles and no emission pose.
diagnosis.otherCorrectionBeforeInitialRun: Zero dt with unchanged actor clock preserves the WeakMap cue without mutation; negative/nonfinite steps and inconsistent clock jumps reject it.

positiveRun.harness: Actual production engine and authored catalogue; DOM/RAF/Image doubles, real PNG dimensions/hashes, recorded Canvas calls rather than raster pixels.

firstAttempt.result: Invalid as causal evidence: all three stopped in the loader because the Node test child registered it twice. Logs retained. No tests reached their causal assertion.

mutants.loaderCorrection: Accept exactly one existing marker with no remaining original hook on a repeated loader pass; otherwise require one unique original hook. Repository source bytes are never written.

validRuns.failure: actual rest-1; expected emission after a retained native projectile
actual emission; expected recovery after native clock advancement
unexpected emission after the outer insertion layer withheld the projectile

preservedBehavior: Physical adult body 170x210, floor 570, four native phases, same projectile centre origin x+w/2,y+h*.48 and unchanged damage/cadence/math.
Only the current queen-mother-song adult owns the art and transient cue; actor/scene identity rejects obsolete resume owners.
Atomic 3-source admission; every incomplete source mask falls back to the complete old vector body.
Five direct draws in GL,SL,body,GP,SP order; body reference height 593 and arm scales fixed per part, no per-cell resize.
Native name and HP remain outside mirrored body transforms. Windup ellipse and seven strokes remain above the artwork, including residual windup on the corpse.
Pause/zero-step, modulo wrap, missing target/stun/offscreen expiry, late image delivery, resume and neighboring ecosystem actors tested.
No persisted marker, added actor field, gameplay event or render mutation.
visualLimits: Independent native raster review is separate from these command-recording tests.
Emission crest/HP margin is tight (~1.17 logical pixels from source geometry) and neutralized near-hand/floor margin is ~0.15 pixel; native raster checks required.
Death alpha is .3 per component, not guaranteed group transparency; overlaps accumulate opacity and far arms can show through.
Four hands are intended for live poses; neutralized far hands may be occluded. No canonical 1:1 certification.

observations: Four arms remain composed; live hands are distinct at the reviewed native scale.
Original native anticipation warning is retained above the five art layers.
Cadaver overlaps and the residual windup warning are visible before expiry; body, name and warning disappear by the observed1.25second sample.
Native reinforcements partially occlude the cadaver and overlap their labels.

evidenceAvailability: The three PNGs, runtime code, provenance, report and overview are repository sources. Per-frame capture names and scratch harness/log names identify retained development evidence; these raw captures and harnesses are not additional public runtime assets.
